page.title: Deck Audio Generator
page.subtitle: Generate native-quality pronunciation audio for all vocabulary and example sentences across your decks via Flama Audio Companion.
page.empty_scan_alert: No cards found requiring audio generation
page.toast_connect_required: Please connect the Flama Audio Desktop app before starting.
page.section_deck_tree_desc: Select the deck you want to generate audio for from the deck hierarchy below. The system will scan audio fields, check source fields, and detect corrupted files.
page.no_deck_selected_desc: Click a deck in the left hierarchy to analyze data and configure audio.
page.scanning_detail_desc: Reading field structures, verifying audio links, and checking disk file integrity.
page.mode_missing_broken_desc: Generate for {{count}} missing or corrupted audio notes (Fast & economical).
page.mode_all_desc: Generate fresh audio for all {{count}} notes in this deck.
page.rule_section_desc: Automatically detected from "Audio" / "_audio" suffixes. You can add separate voice configurations for each field (+ Add).
page.ready_to_generate_status: Ready to generate audio with {{count}} voice configuration(s)
page.queue_section_desc: The system processes queued decks sequentially. Progress is persisted continuously and resumes upon page reload.

gate.description: Flama Audio is a desktop companion application (port 4791) delivering high quality, unlimited offline neural text-to-speech powered by VoiceVox & Kokoro TTS.
gate.step_1: 1. Open the Flama Audio application on your computer.
gate.step_2: 2. Verify the default port is set to 4791.
gate.step_3: 3. Click the retry connection button below.
gate.offline_instruction: Please launch the Flama Audio app on your computer (port 4791). After launching, click "Check Again".
gate.pairing_instruction: Open the Flama Audio Desktop window and click Approve Pairing for the challenge code below:

dialog.mixed_note_types_warning: This deck contains multiple note types. Audio rules will be applied per note type.
